g.text: ground each run to it separately; keep R4, D1, C1, U3 and R2/R3 off the heater return.

g.desc: ground each run to it separately; keep R4, D1, C1, U3 and R2/R3 off the heater return.

g.text: Layout: one star ground at the negative terminal of C2. The heater return, the buck converter and the analog

g.desc: Layout: one star ground at the negative terminal of C2. The heater return, the buck converter and the analog

g.text: R1 is a 2-pad 2512 shunt: route the INA240 inputs as a Kelvin connection at its pads.

g.desc: R1 is a 2-pad 2512 shunt: route the INA240 inputs as a Kelvin connection at its pads.

g.text: See docs/T12 Controller Design.md. Untested: prototype on a current-limited bench supply.

g.desc: See docs/T12 Controller Design.md. Untested: prototype on a current-limited bench supply.

g.text: Everything on +24V_SW must be rated 60 V or more: the TVS can clamp as high as 45 V.

g.desc: Everything on +24V_SW must be rated 60 V or more: the TVS can clamp as high as 45 V.

g.text: ESP32 T12 / T15 soldering tip controller, 24 V - protected reference design

g.desc: ESP32 T12 / T15 soldering tip controller, 24 V - protected reference design

g.text: LMR36510 values follow the datasheet 3.3 V example (22 uH, 3 x 22 uF out, 100k / 43.2k): check them.

g.desc: LMR36510 values follow the datasheet 3.3 V example (22 uH, 3 x 22 uF out, 100k / 43.2k): check them.

g.text: The buck output also feeds the DevKit 3V3 pin: do not power the board from USB and 24 V at once.

g.desc: The buck output also feeds the DevKit 3V3 pin: do not power the board from USB and 24 V at once.
